entries.name: Ambush
entries.summary: A rushing threat that can return after passing.
body: Stay close to a hiding place between passes.

entries.name: Eyes
entries.summary: A glowing cluster that hurts players who look at it.

entries.name: Dupe
entries.summary: False numbered doors punish careless entry.
body: Track the sequence as you enter each room.

entries.name: Figure
entries.summary: A major Hotel threat encountered in the Library and Electrical Room.
facts: Temporary stun, not a full banish
body: Watch its route and keep space. Crouching is not permission to walk into Figure or remain directly in its path.

entries.name: Halt
entries.summary: An encounter that asks you to change direction as it blocks the route.
body: Follow the encounter cues instead of relying on a fixed room number or an old guaranteed-spawn claim.

entries.name: Timothy
entries.summary: A small spider jumps from a looted container and briefly startles the player.
body: Timothy is a looting hazard, not a hallway chase. Recover your view and continue checking the room for other threats.

entries.name: Room Key
entries.summary: A key belongs to a specific locked door.
body: Search accessible areas before spending another tool. A scrambled label during Dupe is not a reliable shortcut to the correct exit.

entries.name: Lockpick
entries.summary: A consumable tool can bypass many ordinary locks.
body: It is useful when finding a normal room key would take time. Check the type of lock before expecting it to work.

entries.name: Flashlight
entries.summary: A directional light that needs battery charge.
body: Save charge for dark sections. An empty flashlight needs batteries rather than repeated attempts to switch it on.

entries.name: Lighter
entries.summary: A small fuel-based light for nearby surroundings.
body: Turn it off when light is unnecessary. Lighting it can make sound, so consider nearby threats before using it.

entries.name: Vitamins
entries.summary: A consumable gives a temporary movement-speed boost.
body: Use the speed for a planned route. It does not replace learning a chase path or watching obstacles.

entries.name: Crucifix
entries.summary: A held defensive item can restrain eligible entities.
facts: Seek and Figure only briefly stunned
body: Keep moving during a boss stun. A temporary restraint is not a completed chase or permission to stand beside the boss.

meta.scope: 12 selected threats and supplies for ordinary Hotel runs on PC and mobile. Not a complete DOORS encyclopedia. Modifiers and other floors can change these rules. Community article text was checked through the search index; direct Fandom access was blocked.
